spanish: Y se encendió nariz de Jehová en el día aquel, y juró, diciendo:

findings.issue: אַף is tagged HTa affirmation while lemma 639 is the noun; «nariz» resolves that split as the noun nose and makes it the subject of וַיִּחַר.

notes: Jehová, en el día aquel, juró, and diciendo match the remaining tokens.
